def run(data):
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env['PYTHONPATH'] = '/workspace/.deps:/workspace/submission'
    env['LD_LIBRARY_PATH'] = '/workspace/native'
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                       input=data, capture_output=True, env=env, timeout=60)
    return p


def main():
    bad = 0
    for name, req in CASES:
        data = json.dumps(req, separators=(',', ':')).encode() if not isinstance(req, str) else req.encode()
        p = run(data)
        out = p.stdout.decode().strip()
        if p.returncode != 0 or out != '{"error":"invalid_request"}':
            print('BAD', name, 'rc', p.returncode, 'out', out[:120], p.stderr.decode()[-200:])
            bad += 1
    for name, raw in RAW:
        if raw is None:
            data = b'{"cases":[]}\xff'
        else:
            data = raw.encode('utf-8') if name != 'non-utf8' else raw
        p = run(data)
        out = p.stdout.decode().strip()
        if p.returncode != 0 or out != '{"error":"invalid_request"}':
            print('BAD', name, 'rc', p.returncode, 'out', out[:120], p.stderr.decode()[-200:])

        bad += 1

    r = json.dumps(mut(relax=[2, 1]), separators=(',', ':')).encode()
    p = run(r)
    if p.returncode != 0 or '"error"' in p.stdout.decode():
        print('BAD unreduced relax rejected', p.stdout.decode()[:200])
        bad += 1
    print('illegal-input battery: failures', bad)


if __name__ == '__main__':
